source: debates/D022_datasets_kan/05_judge_audit_revision.md sections 2.1-2.8 (decision row D022a); every number is a design choice fixed before any result
bic_margin_note: appendix field only: computed on the KAN's grid, not a data statistic; it licenses nothing

wording.results_sentence: Of the {n} inputs of the extracted {law} law, the audit licensed the form of {j} and the sign of {s}; {a} were not identified and {p} were not retained by the extraction.
wording.scope_sentence: The extraction rule, its thresholds and the calibration design are fixed by the frozen commit and verified by re-run.
wording.bic_caveat: BIC is computed on the KAN's grid, not on the data
wording.approx_input: the cap-2 form is an approximation of the arm's own parent effect (extraction-loss flag)
wording.discussion_sentence: Readable means that the extracted law is a short closed form that can be written out and evaluated; the audit reports separately which of its effects the training design identifies.
wording.not_identified_input: the audit does not license a form for this effect

failure.calibration: The extraction audit did not meet its pre-set calibration condition, so it is reported as a description, not as a method result.
failure.usefulness: The extraction audit did not meet its pre-set usefulness condition, so it is reported as a description, not as a method result.
failure.necessity: The extraction audit did not meet its pre-set necessity condition, so it is reported as a description, not as a method result.
